steps.title: Prohibited actions guardrail
steps.note: The review engine refuses to mutate bot identity, memory, skills, credentials, financial records, or another bot's files. The PROHIBITED_ACTIONS list surfaces these domains in natural language.

steps.title: Conflict detection
steps.note: Checkpoints are grouped by taskId. If multiple bots report different owners, statuses, or conclusions for the same task, the engine emits an alert-level conflict notification.

steps.title: Evidence requirement
steps.note: A completed checkpoint without evidence (URL, file path, commit hash, or explicit verification statement) is flagged as missing_evidence. This prevents bots from claiming done without proof.

steps.title: Sensitive domain escalation
steps.note: If a checkpoint result or next step mentions payment, credentials, deploy, production, client messages, or publishing, the task is escalated for owner review regardless of status.
